proposal.summary: Improper input validation in the CLI of Cisco Secure Email Gateway allows an authenticated remote attacker with Administrator credentials to inject OS commands into a legitimate command, potentially escaping the restricted prompt and executing arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system.
proposal.affected_product: Cisco Secure Email Gateway; versions not specified
proposal.cwe_quote: This vulnerability is due to improper input validation in the CLI. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by injecting operating system commands into a legitimate command.

AV.quote: could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

PR.quote: To successfully exploit this vulnerability, an attacker would need valid Administrator credentials.

S.quote: execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system.

C.quote: execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system.

I.quote: execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request affected Cisco Secure Email Gateway versions, reproduce steps or PoC, and obtain CLI command examples showing injection to confirm impact and craft mitigations.
